# rustinion_escalation_acknowledgement (Resource)

Acknowledges a rustinion_alert_rule or rustinion_log_alert_rule's currently-firing escalation, stopping it from advancing to its next step — the Terraform-managed counterpart to the admin UI's own "Acknowledge" button. This models a one-shot action, not persistent configuration: applying it acknowledges the rule's current escalation episode once. Read re-checks the server and drops this resource from state the moment the acknowledgement no longer holds (the rule cleared and fired again, starting a fresh unacknowledged episode) — a later apply then re-acknowledges the new episode. There is no way to un-acknowledge server-side, so destroying this resource only forgets it in Terraform's own state, it does not resume escalation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (String) ID of the alert rule or log alert rule to acknowledge.
- `rule_kind` (String) "alert_rule" or "log_alert_rule".

### Read-Only

- `acknowledged_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the server recorded the acknowledgement at.
- `current_step` (Number) The escalation step the run was on at the moment it was acknowledged.
- `id` (String) "<rule_kind>/<rule_id>" — this resource's own import identifier.
